e: Borrowed from New Latin eguttulatus, eguttulata; see guttulate.
q: Conidia dry, holoblastic, solitary, cylindrical, straight to slightly curved, often slightly constricted at septae, 16–35 × 6.5–9.5 μm, apex rounded 4–5 μm, base 4.5–6 μm, 2–7 transversally distoseptate, hilum inconspicuous, eguttulate, pale brown to brown, smooth walled but faintly spirally sulcate along the conidial length.
